model.box: oriented red-car box 2.0 x 1.55 x 4.0 m projected with the frame pinhole model, clipped
model.estimator: WorldEstimateFilter with the frozen BODY-001 priors and sigma_px
model.gimbal: ideal pointing at the car box centre, 45 deg clamp, saturation above limit + 0.1 deg

noise.E1: box centre + N(0, sigma_px) px per axis
noise.E2: box centre + N(0, 2 sigma_px) px per axis; reported camera attitude + N(0, sigma_att_deg) per axis

model.plant: float32 mirror of TetheredDronePlant.Step (AC-19 golden vectors)
model.short_side_px: 2.0 m * fy / slant range to the car box centre
model.threshold_in_untethered_cells: ThresholdBodyPlanner without corridor prisms (same as the embedded fallback)

selection_rule.H3: zero fence-violation and zero inside-inflated-prism (2.1 m) frames; boundary/obstacle modifier share <= 0.01
selection_rule.tie_break: shortest second-loop path; paths within 3 % are tied -> fewer start-stops -> lower candidate number
